method: Sequential isolated copies on the same filesystem. Same learner, optimizer, replay, RNG, worker sequences, 8 actors, 400 simulations/ply. Reset only copied update_schedule consumed_positions to copied replay total_positions, forcing >=4096 newly committed positions. Normal pipeline with monitor on (ephemeral port), performance on, stop_after_publications=1. Timer starts before pipeline initialization, ends when new actor export returns; startup export excluded as a publication. No concurrent benchmark workloads.
limitations: One complete publication per variant; no long-run confidence interval.
Self-play trajectories can differ with BF16 batch scheduling; complete-game admission produces different overshoot and unfinished-game work.
Cold startup/first SGD and disk writes included; continuous steady-state publication intervals may differ.
No strength claim; search budget, exploration parameters, model architecture and SGD settings unchanged.

notes: Cumulative current-session rates; startup and unfinished searches are included in wall time
MCTS local CPU is a wall-time estimate, not process CPU time
Request RTT includes inference and queueing; it is not pure IPC overhead
Concurrent module times overlap and must not be added
P95 is a fixed-histogram approximate upper bound
CUDA events are sampled and read without additional synchronization
